title: Erfolg Living
description: Industry work — a live commercial site built end to end.

caseStudy.context: A commercial presence for an interiors brand, with the opening centred on the atmosphere of a finished space.

decisions.title: Architecture sets the rhythm.
decisions.text: Repeated arches establish a strong central axis. Keeping the headline on that axis creates a clear relationship between the words and the room.

decisions.title: Typography carries the positioning.
decisions.text: Wide-spaced capitals and an italic accent differentiate the statement from the smaller navigation. The image remains the largest element in the composition.

decisions.title: A direct route to the collection.
decisions.text: The outlined collection action appears below the positioning line, providing an explicit next step through the image-led opening.

caseStudy.reflection: The opening establishes atmosphere quickly. A fuller case study should also examine product discovery, small-screen crops, and the route from browsing to enquiry; those materials have not yet been supplied.

title: Casa&Crop
description: Industry work — a live commercial site built end to end.

caseStudy.context: A commercial website presenting furnishings through a richly composed interior scene.

decisions.title: Show the objects in a setting.
decisions.text: Furniture, lighting, and accessories appear together in a full-frame room. The composition communicates a visual world before asking visitors to inspect individual objects.

decisions.title: Keep the identity quiet.
decisions.text: The white wordmark sits in the upper-left corner with little competing text, allowing the photography to define the opening.

decisions.title: Indicate that there is more.
decisions.text: A slim numbered index at the right and a downward cue suggest further scenes beyond this first composition.

caseStudy.reflection: The image carries much of the message. Clear product labels, keyboard access, image compression, and alternate mobile crops are important evaluation points when extending this direction.

title: Quorum
description: Sends four people a private form about you — collects their honest takes, keeps them sealed until all four respond.

caseStudy.context: An independent experiment that invites four people to answer one question privately and combines their words into a personal keepsake.

decisions.title: Put the idea into one sentence.
decisions.text: The central headline explains the four-person premise. Its italic accent highlights the phrase that distinguishes the experience.

decisions.title: Explain before asking.
decisions.text: A short paragraph describes the invitation and private response process before the main action.

decisions.title: Offer action and explanation.
decisions.text: “Start a Quorum” is the dominant action, with “How it works” beside it. The opening gives a curious visitor a path to learn before beginning.

caseStudy.reflection: The opening explains the premise. The project’s privacy wording and invitation/reveal flow should be assessed against its live implementation; this portfolio does not claim a security audit or measured engagement uplift.
